rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Not Until You Explain
card.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five's when I booked it. The driver came at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay and show me where it says booking time. I'll drive you once this hour makes sense.

card.title: Not Until You Explain
card.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.

card.title: Approve the Cover Story
card.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you back 'collecting chairs' when the caretaker asks why we opened the props cupboard? We need him to lend us the hall again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Chairs don't fit in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Checking for folding stools, then. Can you back that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Will you sign the hall request with me?

card.title: Approve the Cover Story
card.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can you approve 'delivery delay' in the newsletter? I don't want our new volunteer blamed for the melted cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She delivered it on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'storage problem'. Will you approve that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we mention the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. 'Storage problem; full refund arranged.' Can I put your name under it?

card.title: You Handle the Evidence
card.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the raffle cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes. I can't face explaining the broken lock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My office doesn't lock either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take it home. You can hand it to her tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You handle the count and explain the lock; I'll send you the key that snapped.

card.title: You Handle the Evidence
card.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time he made me unload his van before he'd do any paperwork.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then meet him early. Get my receipt before you start unloading, so you can take it straight to the treasurer.

card.title: Back My Version
card.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The allotment committee's asking about the greenhouse. We arrived after the glass broke, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saw your wheelbarrow hit it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We came inside afterwards. Can we both tell them we were clearing up?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say that. I won't lie about the wheelbarrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then start with clearing up. If they ask about the barrow, we moved it away afterwards. Let's both use that order.

card.title: Back My Version
card.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The caretaker's asking about our extra key. Tell him we were checking the cake cupboard's lock.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We did check it. Then we ate the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the part we both remember as maintenance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll ask why there are crumbs in the lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we both remember a blockage. Say that back so we're consistent.

card.title: Test the Story First
card.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try this banking-delay explanation for the missing raffle money on the chair before I sign it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not defending your accounts again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just test the explanation. If she accepts it, I'll sign and handle every question.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll recognise your handwriting before I speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the paper. Ask whether a banking delay sounds plausible. If she asks whose money, come back before answering.

card.title: Test the Story First
card.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask Dad why our holiday account's empty. I'll wait by the kitchen door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come with me. You booked the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he's angry about the price first. If he isn't, I'll come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm calling you in if he wants the flight receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he wants the total or the breakdown before you call me. The seat upgrades need a longer explanation.
